issues: project_relevance misstated the precision regimes: claimed precision below 0.45 hurts the agent, but facts show Jina at 0.445 is neutral and only BM25 at 0.375 degrades performance.

corrections.before: 检索器文件精度需越过约0.68才降本，低于0.45反拖累Agent，可作精度基线。
corrections.after: 文件精度约0.38以下反拖累Agent，0.45左右中性，越过约0.68才降本，可作精度基线。
corrections.reason: Facts establish three regimes: BM25 at file-precision 0.375 degrades the agent, Jina-1.5B at 0.445 is neutral, CodeGrep at 0.677 buys efficiency; the neutral-to-net-positive transition lies in (0.45, 0.68). The original 'below 0.45 hurts' contradicts the neutral finding at 0.445.
